## Claim amendment · 2026-11-17T07:43Z

From L1-a REWORK 6941942506 on PR #34698 (must-fix): the `.describe()` on `FormField.span` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (:4043) says only textarea, markdown, html, richtext and repeater resolve to the full column count; after this card a file or image field declared `multiple: true` does too, so the published text would be false. Seat ruling: fix it in this card, not a follow-up.

File surface widens to:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the `FormField.span` describe text only)
- the outputs regenerated from it: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` and the matching `packages/spec/json-schema/**` file(s)
- the changeset gains `'@objectstack/spec': patch`
